reasons: Role 1 fails as a wide high-oblique editorial hero; the image is a ground-level shot with an oversized product package that dominates the frame instead of appearing small and off-center.

Role 2 fails as an elevated technical comparison; the camera angle is low and static, duplicating the perspective of Role 1, and it does not effectively demonstrate diameter or construction differences between the coils.
Role 3 fails because the coil products are oversized and visually compete for attention rather than remaining small and secondary to the equipment record.
The set lacks a distinct change in camera height and technical narrative across the three roles.
history.correction_prompt: Redesign the three panels by elevating and separating the camera angles: role 1 should be a high-oblique wide shot with the small coils off-center, role 2 should be a macro-style elevated comparison showing construction differences, and role 3 should be an equipment-focused shot where the pump and manifold are the primary subjects with the coils strictly secondary.
